question: As reported in August 2025, which of the following relief measures did exporters request from the government and Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to help with financial strain caused by US tariffs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Relaxation on loan repayments**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **August 2025**, Indian export bodies and trade associations formally approached the **Government of India** and the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** to seek immediate financial relief due to the imposition of restrictive **US tariffs** on Indian goods.
 
• The primary demand was the **Relaxation on loan repayments**, which includes a request for a **moratorium** on principal and interest payments for a specified period to help businesses manage a severe **liquidity crunch**.
 
• Exporters highlighted that the high tariffs in the **United States** have significantly reduced their **profit margins** and disrupted **cash flows**, making it difficult to adhere to original **debt servicing schedules**.
 
• The request specifically targets the extension of the **pre-shipment and post-shipment export credit** cycles from the current **270 days** to up to 15 m
